content: To prepare and administer Cefuroxime using ADD-Vantage® vials, follow these detailed instructions: Opening the Diluent Container: 1. Begin by peeling back the corner of the ADD-Vantage diluent overwrap and removing the flexible diluent container. 2. Note that some cloudiness or opacity in the plastic container may be visible due to moisture absorption during sterilization. This is a normal occurrence and does not compromise the quality or safety of the solution. The opacity will gradually clear over time. Assembling the Vial and Diluent Container (Aseptic Technique Required): 1. Remove Protective Covers: For the vial: Swing the pull ring over the top of the vial and pull it downward to initiate the opening. Then, pull the ring straight upward to fully remove the breakaway cap. Important: Once the breakaway cap is removed, do not attempt to access the vial with a syringe. For the vial port on the diluent container: Grasp the pull ring tab, pull upward to break the three tie strings, and then pull back to remove the cover. 2. Attach the Vial to the Diluent Container: Screw the vial into the vial port until it is fully secured. This typically requires turning the vial approximately one-half turn (180°) beyond the first audible click. Note: The clicking sound alone does not confirm a seal; continue turning the vial until it cannot be tightened further. Once the vial is securely attached, do not attempt to remove it. 3. Verify the Seal: Double-check that the vial is tightly secured by attempting to turn it further in the direction of assembly. 4. Label the Container: Preparing the Admixture: 1. Gently squeeze the bottom of the diluent container to inflate the area surrounding the end of the drug vial. 2. Using your other hand, push the drug vial downward into the container, causing the walls of the container to telescope. Grasp the inner cap of the vial through the container walls. 3. Remove the inner cap from the drug vial. 4. Thoroughly mix the contents of the container. Use the prepared solution within the specified time frame. Preparing for Administration (Aseptic Technique Required): 1. Confirm that the vial contents have been activated and properly mixed with the diluent. 2. Check the container for leaks by firmly squeezing it. If any leaks are detected, discard the unit as sterility may be compromised. 3. Close the flow control clamp on the administration set. 4. Remove the cover from the outlet port located at the bottom of the container. 5. Insert the piercing pin of the administration set into the outlet port using a twisting motion until the pin is securely seated. Note: Refer to the full instructions provided on the administration set carton for additional guidance. 6. Prepare the container for hanging: Lift the free end of the hanger loop located at the bottom of the vial. Break the two tie strings and bend the loop outward to lock it in an upright position. Suspend the container from the hanger. 7. Establish the fluid level in the drip chamber by squeezing and releasing it. 8. Open the flow control clamp to clear air from the administration set, then close the clamp. 9. Attach the administration set to the venipuncture device. If the device is not indwelling, prime the set and perform venipuncture. 10. Adjust the rate of administration using the flow control clamp. Warning: Do not use the flexible container in series connections, as this may compromise the integrity of the system.
